_comment: Fields where the Overframe oracle is demonstrably wrong and our data is verified in game. Skipped by tools/calibrate.ts and tools/audit.ts so a green run means something. Each entry carries its evidence; do not add one without it.

multishot.evidence: In-game arsenal shows Multishot 1, Crit 16%, Status 24% — identical to our data. The oracle is exactly +1.0 over what its own mods can produce.
In-game arsenal: primary beam Multishot 6, Status 22.2%, Crit 11%; alt-fire Multishot 1 with 3% crit / 37% status on both the bomb and the radial. Our data matches all of it.

statusChance.evidence: In-game status chance is 22.2% on the beam; Overframe reports the per-shot probability instead (see docs/data-notes.md).
The oracle equals 1-(1-0.06)^1.9, i.e. the chance of at least one proc per shot. A 120-build sweep shows the oracle is per-projectile in 112 of them, so this is an inconsistency on their side.

fireRate.evidence: Semi-Shotgun Cannonade's text is 'Fire Rate cannot be modified', so Critical Deceleration's -20% must not apply. The oracle applies the penalty for shotguns but blocks it for rifles (Latron Prime build 464476), contradicting itself on its own rule. Given two oracles errors already proven in game (Ocucor, Phantasma Prime) and Acceltra's per-shot artefact, our reading of the mod text is the better evidence.

reloadTime.evidence: Felarx reloads shell by shell. The wiki page gives 0.8s to start, 0.5s to end and 0.4s per shell, so 3.7s for its 6 shells, and the Public Export, WFCD and the wiki weapon module all list 3.7s. Overframe's 6.5s matches none of them.
